How should the 'Choose music' library browser be organized?

❯ 1. Tabs + action buttons        ┌───────────────────────────────────────────┐
  2. Pick, then choose mode       │ Choose Music                 Done         │
                                  │   🔍 Search your library                  │
                                  │   [Shuffle all songs][Shuffle all albums] │
                                  │   Playlists Artists Albums Genres Songs   │
                                  │             ▔▔▔▔▔▔▔                       │
                                  │   Portishead                     ▸        │
                                  │   Radiohead                      ▸        │
                                  │   …                                       │
                                  │                                           │
                                  │   ── tap Radiohead ──▶                    │
                                  │   Radiohead · 9 albums · 112 songs        │
                                  │   [▶ In order][🔀 Songs][💿 Albums]       │
                                  │   OK Computer (1997)             ▸        │
                                  │   Kid A (2000)                   ▸        │
                                  └───────────────────────────────────────────┘

                                  Notes: press n to add notes
